name: Licenses required to build AI
definition: Requires a license, registration, certification, or government permission before developing, training, or deploying an AI system or model.
pattern: require government permission before an AI system may be built or deployed
head: permission needed to build AI

name: Caps on who can train models
definition: Sets compute, cost, or capability thresholds that trigger restrictions or obligations on who may train or release large AI models.
pattern: set a threshold above which a company may not train or release a model freely
head: limits on who may train a model

name: Limits on sharing open models
definition: Restricts publishing, sharing, or open-sourcing AI model weights or code.
pattern: restrict who may publish or share model weights
head: limits on sharing open models

name: ID and age checks for users
definition: Requires identity verification, age verification, or know-your-customer checks for users, customers, or buyers of AI services or compute.
pattern: have an AI service check the identity or age of the people who use it
head: ID checks on people who use AI

name: Mandatory reporting to government
definition: Requires people or companies outside government that develop, deploy, or operate AI systems, or own or operate data centers, to report, disclose, register, or submit plans, incidents, audits, impact assessments, or other information to a government body, or to produce them on government demand. A government body reporting on its own use of AI does not count.
pattern: require a company to file reports with a government body, or hand them over on demand
head: reports companies must file with the government

name: Labels and notices of AI use
definition: Requires labels, watermarks, provenance data, or disclosures on AI-generated content or AI interactions, or requires a company, employer, insurer, landlord, or other private party to tell the people it uses AI on that it is using it.
pattern: require a label, watermark, or disclosure on AI content, or a notice to the people AI is used on
head: labels and notices of AI use

name: Bans and limits on uses of AI
definition: Bans or restricts a use of AI by people or organizations outside government: forbids it outright or for a purpose or setting, such as setting rents, giving therapy or denying insurance claims; requires that a person rather than an AI make or review a decision; requires an AI system to be built so it cannot be used a certain way; or makes creating or spreading AI-made content a crime or a civil violation. Rules for the government's own use of AI do not count.
head: bans and limits on uses of AI
pattern: ban or restrict a use of AI, or make one a crime

name: New powers for government agencies
definition: Creates a new government office or agency for AI or data centers, or gives an existing agency or attorney general new authority over AI, data centers, or the people and companies who build or use AI, to make rules, inspect, license, or enforce. An office that only oversees the government's own use of AI does not count.
pattern: create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers
head: new authority over AI or data centers for a government body

name: Export controls on models and chips
definition: Restricts exports or foreign access to AI chips, models, compute, or AI technology.
pattern: restrict which chips, models, or compute may leave the country
head: limits on chips and models leaving the country

name: State laws overridden by Washington
definition: A federal measure that overrides, preempts, or blocks state or local AI laws, or conditions federal funding on states not regulating AI.
pattern: override what a state or city may decide about AI for itself
head: state AI laws overridden

name: Moratoriums and limits on data centers
definition: Pauses, bans, or adds new permitting restrictions or special conditions on building or operating data centers.
pattern: pause data centers, or add conditions on building and running them
head: limits on building data centers
